item.title: YouTube's CEO limits his kids' social media use – other tech bosses do the same
item.description:
"We do limit their time on YouTube and other platforms and other forms of media. Mohan said in a more extensive interview with Time on Wednesday that he feels a "paramount responsibility" to young people and giving parents greater control over how their kids use the platform. With three children, now adults, Gates openly talked about not giving them cell phones until they were in their teens.

HN Discussion

Read Original Article

Top 4 Comments:

concinds:

Meanwhile “normal” (neglectful) parents give iPads or internet-connected computers to 5-year olds. Losers keep losing. Never stood a chance.

mattgreenrocks:

All ages benefit from time-limited exposure to social media. We have a term for it now: brainrot. Fully convinced it is the cigarettes of our generation: ubiquitous enough to be pervasive despite negative externalities.

rightbyte:

Ye and Zuckerberg plugs the laptop mic with a dud cable.

I guess most parents try to limit screen time. But some have a hard time doing it since it is a great babysitter.

I try to do a total blockade of YT at home for kids. Watching other kids be hypnothized by the feed years ago was enough. The algorithm seems to converge to unboxing videos and surreal spam.

michaeljx:

I am sure the coca-cola boss limits his kids soft drink consumption too.
